Dana (partnerships): Quick note: Zenara preview units arriving next Wed. Need NDA, customs, and a short go/no-go checklist. Who owns bench sign-off? cc @Marco @Li @Zoe
Marco (partner-ops): Ill handle shipping + customs. Carrier ETA Wed 14:00. I need rack U and max draw.
Li (hw-eng): Hardware: 3 nodes, 1U each, 1.1kW sustained per rack. Firmware tags: zen-1.0-stable and zen-1.1-rc (perf changes). Recommend baseline on stable then upgrade.
Zoe (bench): I can own bench validation. Minimal tests: single-stream latency seq=4096, batch4 throughput, 4h soak, and a 200-sample quality spot check vs redwood/v1.2. Acceptance: p99 within 10% and quality delta <1%.
Erin (legal): NDA draft received. Ive redlined telemetry and embargo clauses. Sending to partner counsel now; need signed copy by Tue EOD.
ShipBot: Calendar created: "Zenara Preview - Lab Week" Wed-Fri. Invitees: Dana, Marco, Li, Zoe, Erin.
Dana (partnerships): Thanks. Action items: Erin - NDA sign by Tue; Marco - confirm customs + rack by Tue EOD; Li - capture firmware + kernel versions on arrival; Zoe - bench runner + feedback template by Mon.
Zoe (bench): Runner snippet for infra: 
```bash
./bench_run --model redwood/v1.2 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --out s3://redwood-preview/zenara/metrics.json
```
Will export p50/p95/p99 and token timing traces.
Li (hw-eng): If we see weird jitter, grab dmesg, lspci, and vendor module versions. I'll reserve isolated GPU nodes in case we need passthrough.
Marco (partner-ops): Shipping labels and commercial invoice uploaded to drive. Tracking visible; will post link.
Dana (partnerships): Good. Maintain embargo until bench + legal clear. Keeping thread for day-zero notes. :white_check_mark:
